page.overview:
Who is Big Bad Wolf?

The Big Bad Wolf is the enemy in The 3 Little Pigs and Little Red Riding Hood. He blows down houses by simply huffing and puffing. He eats Red Riding Hood's Grandma until the Woodcutter comes and frees Grandma and the Wolf runs away.

He tries to gobble up the pigs and succeeds in blowing down two of their houses, made of straw and wood. However, he fails to blow down the other pig's house, which is made of brick. The wolf runs away after he burns his tail.
